item.title: Infinite Discs' month-long Black Friday sale enters its final week
item.description:
Infinite Discs' Black Friday sale — running all month — has entered its fourth and final week, with three more brands discounted through Sunday: Prodigy, Gateway, and a third brand featured in the post. The deals cover the brands' disc lineups at reduced prices, with Prodigy highlights including a special Alien stamp run.

If you've been waiting to stock up on favorite molds, this is the last week of the month-long event, and the brand rotation means the discounts change weekly rather than repeating. Check the post for the full list of what's on sale and the links to each brand's discounted discs before the week ends.
